headline: A green build is now a content-bound attestation of the exact complete plan and source, not a counter someone can repeat.

items.title: Complete measured build entrypoint
items.insight: All 253 release and security gates now execute behind one measured runner; tails remain inspectable but can never impersonate completeness.

items.title: Plan- and source-bound evidence
items.insight: Receipts bind both the live command plan and verification-relevant source bytes, closing stale-green after code or gate edits.

items.title: Classified proof surface
items.insight: Blocking and advisory proof share one measured surface without erasing enforcement boundaries.

items.title: Atomic integrity-bound evidence pairs
items.insight: JSON and Markdown twins write atomically, carry content IDs, and self-validate after persistence.

items.title: Fail-closed startup and closeout truth
items.insight: Startup, closeout, and status reject partial, stale-plan, stale-source, aged, or mismatched evidence.

items.title: Content-stable transitive Genius cache
items.insight: Static, dynamic, and side-effect imports invalidate the actionable list by bytes rather than timestamps.

items.title: Task ownership and agent discovery truth
items.insight: External waits stay gated, consolidation history stops false mismatch alerts, and agents discover public-safe verification receipts.

items.title: Exact candidate staging
items.insight: The verified working tree is deployed atomically with rollback and passes candidate-green parity while production remains honestly held.

followUps: Bind staging deploy provenance, rollback, parity, and candidate identity in one durable receipt.
Validate diagnostic receipt schemas before agents.json advertises them.
blockers: Production provider/control-plane and real-provider evidence remain incomplete.
Fresh RUM and a real recovery transition remain external evidence waits.

honestyLedger.title: No partial green
honestyLedger.why: A resumed tail cannot be validated as a complete suite.

honestyLedger.title: No staging-to-production inference
honestyLedger.why: Candidate-green staging does not satisfy the held identity/provider interlock.

honestyLedger.title: No sibling edits or fabricated evidence
honestyLedger.why: Both external follow-ups used signed Ark cargo; telemetry and provider proof were not invented.
